plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim CRWD to 15% to reduce single name concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index and quality tech. It aims for a more stable growth path than aggressive modes.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Buy GOOGL to 6% and AMD to 5% to add high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in strong setups for stretch growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
